facts: Tony McEvoy stated Half Yours would resume in the Group 1 All Aged Stakes at Randwick before a Queensland preparation.
The stated Queensland sequence was Hollindale Stakes 1800m, Doomben Cup 2000m and Q22 2200m.
The stated Melbourne spring plan was Makybe Diva Stakes 1600m, Turnbull Stakes 2000m, Cox Plate 2000m at Flemington, then Melbourne Cup 3200m if all went well.

A 22 May 2026 report documented mild right-hind lameness on pre-race veterinary inspection ahead of the Doomben Cup, requiring a further race-morning examination. This is retained as dated preparation evidence, not treated as a continuing injury diagnosis.
Won the 2026 Australian Cup over 2000m at Flemington with an explicitly published RAS run rating of 121.
Racing & Sports' Australian Cup preview explicitly described his 2025 Australian Cup 122 as his career peak at that time.
